description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!   
At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.   
 Job Description: 
 Parsons is seeking a Full Stack Software Engineer to develop secure, resilient software supporting critical U.S. Government and Department of Defense missions. In this role, you will build modern user interfaces with React and TypeScript, develop scalable backend services using Java and Node.js, and deploy containerized applications with Docker and Kubernetes.
 You will work across the full software development lifecycle, collaborating with engineers, product owners, mission users, and operational stakeholders to deliver reliable, mission-focused capabilities in demanding operational environments.

 What You'll Be Doing: 
 Design, develop, integrate, test, and maintain full-stack software applications based on customer and mission requirements.
 Build modern, responsive, and maintainable user interfaces using React, TypeScript, and related UI technologies.
 Translate UI/UX designs and prototypes into functional web applications.
 Develop scalable backend services using Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, and related frameworks.
 Design, implement, and integrate RESTful APIs, WebSocket services, and other web services.
 Develop applications that interact with relational and NoSQL databases.
 Containerize and deploy applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
 Support application development and deployment across the full software development lifecycle.
 Apply DevSecOps practices, including Git-based version control, peer code reviews, automated testing, and continuous integration and delivery.
 Troubleshoot front-end, backend, API, database, and deployment issues.
 Perform root-cause analysis and implement improvements to application performance, reliability, scalability, and security.
 Collaborate with product owners, software engineers, developers, system administrators, cybersecurity professionals, and operational stakeholders.
 Contribute to technical documentation, design reviews, coding standards, and software development processes.
 Support the delivery of software for operational environments that may include limited-bandwidth or disconnected conditions.
 
 Required Clearance: 
 Must be a U.S. Citizen
 Must have an active Secret Clearance. 


 What Required Skills You'll Bring: 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a related technical discipline and 5+ years of related professional experience. Additional years of experience may be considered in lieu of a degree. 
 Professional experience developing production software with React and JavaScript-based technologies.
 Experience developing backend services using Java, Node.js, or both.
 Experience with Java frameworks such as Spring Boot.
 Experience designing, developing, integrating, or consuming RESTful APIs and web services.
 Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes in a software development or deployment environment.
 Experience developing in Linux environments.
 Experience using Git for source control and collaborative software development.
 Experience working with relational databases, NoSQL databases, or both.
 Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
 
 What Desired Skills You'll Bring: 
 Advanced experience with TypeScript, reusable React components, UI libraries, and state-management solutions.
 Experience with Spring MVC, Spring Data, and Spring Security.
 Experience with Maven, Gradle, or other Java build and dependency-management tools.
 Experience deploying applications to AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or other cloud environments.
 Experience supporting DoD cloud, tactical, or operational environments.
 Familiarity with disconnected, intermittent, and limited-bandwidth environments.
 Experience developing or maintaining GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
 Experience with Keycloak, identity and access management, and role-based access control.
 Familiarity with DoD cybersecurity requirements, including Security Technical Implementation Guides.
 Experience with messaging technologies such as JMS or Apache Kafka.
 Experience with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar database technologies.
 Familiarity with Tactical Assault Kit, WebTAK, TAK Server, tactical communications, or mission command systems.
 Experience working in Agile or other iterative software development environments.
 
 Security Clearance Requirement: 
An active Secret security clearance is required for this position.​ 
 
This position is part of our Federal Solutions team. 
 
The Federal Solutions segment delivers resources to our US government customers that ensure the success of missions around the globe. Our intelligent employees drive the state of the art as they provide services and solutions in the areas of defense, security, intelligence, infrastructure, and environmental. We promote a culture of excellence and close-knit teams that take pride in delivering, protecting, and sustaining our nation's most critical assets, from Earth to cyberspace. Throughout the company, our people are anticipating what’s next to deliver the solutions our customers need now. 
 
Salary Range: $103,500.00 - $181,100.00 
 
 
 
We value our employees and want our employees to take care of their overall wellbeing, which is why we offer best-in-class benefits such as medical, dental, vision, paid time off, 401(k), life insurance, flexible work schedules, and holidays to fit your busy lifestyle! 
 
 
 
This position will be posted for a minimum of 3 days and will continue to be posted for an average of 30 days until a qualified applicant is selected or the position has been cancelled. 
 
Parsons is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other protected status. 
 
We truly invest and care about our employee’s wellbeing and provide endless growth opportunities as the sky is the limit, so aim for the stars! Imagine next and join the Parsons quest—APPLY TODAY! 
 Parsons is aware of fraudulent recruitment practices. To learn more about recruitment fraud and how to report it, please refer to   https://www.parsons.com/fraudulent-recruitment/ .
